profile.summary: UlisesGascon is a **Senior JavaScript Developer** specializing in **Node.js and Express.js backend ecosystems**. With **45+ PRs** focused exclusively on Express.js, their contributions demonstrate deep expertise in **framework internals, dependency hygiene, CI/CD tooling, and security practices**. Their work spans **Node.js version compatibility testing, automated dependency updates, static application security testing (SAST), and community governance**, reflecting a **process-driven and security-conscious approach**. While primarily a **backend-focused developer**, their contributions imply familiarity with **JavaScript language features** (e.g., ES Modules, async/await) used in Express middleware and routing systems.
